L1: 
L2: # Telegram Bot API
L3: 
L4: > The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
L5: > To learn how to create and set up a bot, please consult our 【0†Introduction to Bots】 and 【1†Bot FAQ】.
L6: 
L7: ### Recent changes
L8: 
L9: > Subscribe to 【2†@BotNews†t.me】 to be the first to know about the latest updates and join the discussion in 【3†@BotTalk†t.me】
L10: #### November 9, 2026
L11: 
L12: Bot API 10.4
L13: 
L14: Widgets
L15:   * Added the class 【4†Widget】 and the field widget to the classes 【5†Message】 and 【6†ExternalReplyInfo】 for messages with 【7†HTML widgets】.
L16:   * Added the method 【8†sendWidget】, allowing bots to send messages with HTML widgets. Currently, in the production environment, widgets can be sent only to private chats, and sent widgets automatically have protected content and therefore can't be forwarded.
L17:   * Added the method 【9†sendSharedWidget】, allowing bots to send again shared widgets created by the bot.
L18:   * Added the class 【10†WidgetQuery】 and the field widget_query to the class 【11†Update】 for queries sent to the bot by widgets in messages sent by the bot or via the bot.
L19:   * Added the class 【12†SharedWidgetQuery】 and the field shared_widget_query to the class 【11†Update】 for queries sent to the bot from forwarded messages with shared widgets.
L20:   * Added the classes 【13†WidgetQueryType】, 【14†WidgetQueryTypeData】, 【15†WidgetQueryTypeSignData】, 【16†WidgetQueryTypeSentTransaction】 and 【17†WidgetQueryWallet】, describing the type of a query from a widget. A query can contain data for the bot together with the TON wallet card of the user, data signed by a TON wallet of the user, or a notification about a transaction sent from a TON wallet of the user.
L21:   * Added the method 【18†answerWidgetQuery】, allowing bots to answer queries from widgets.
L22:   * Added the method 【19†editMessageWidgetData】, allowing bots to change data of a widget in a message.
L23:   * Added the method 【20†editSharedWidgetData】, allowing bots to change public data of a shared widget.
L24:   * Added the classes 【21†InputWidgetMessageContent】 and 【22†InputSharedWidgetMessageContent】, allowing bots to send widgets in response to inline queries. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.
L25:   * Widget messages can't be copied using the methods 【23†copyMessage】 and 【24†copyMessages】.
L26:   * The right can_send_other_messages in the classes 【25†ChatPermissions】 and 【26†ChatMemberRestricted】 now also allows sending widgets.
L27: Ephemeral messages
L28:   * Allowed bots to send ephemeral replies to callback queries in any chat except channel direct messages chats by specifying callback_query_id without receiver_user_id in the parameter ephemeral_message_parameters of the methods 【27†sendMessage】, 【28†sendRichMessage】, 【29†sendAnimation】, 【30†sendAudio】, 【31†sendContact】, 【32†sendDocument】, 【33†sendLivePhoto】, 【34†sendLocation】, 【35†sendPhoto】, 【36†sendSticker】, 【37†sendVenue】, 【38†sendVideo】, 【39†sendVideoNote】 and 【40†sendVoice】.
L29:   * The field receiver_user_id of the class 【41†EphemeralMessageParameters】 and the parameter chat_id of the mentioned methods are optional now.
L30: Quotes from rich messages
L31: 
L32:   * Added the field rich_texts to the class 【42†TextQuote】 for quotes chosen from a 【43†RichMessage】.
L33:   * Added the field quote_rich_texts to the class 【44†ReplyParameters】, allowing bots to quote rich messages.
L34: 
L35: TON wallet
L36:   * Added the classes 【45†TonWalletCard】, 【46†TonWalletCardSticker】, 【47†TonNft】 and 【48†TonNftAttribute】, and the field ton_wallet_card to the class 【49†ChatFullInfo】.
L37:   * Added the class 【50†TonWalletTransfer】 and the field ton_wallet_transfer to the class 【5†Message】 for service messages about transfers with a TON wallet.
L38:   * Renamed the class StoryAreaPosition to 【51†AreaPosition】, because it is now also used to describe the position of stickers on TON wallet cards.
L39: 
L40: Chat share themes
L41:   * Added the classes 【52†ChatShareTheme】, 【53†ChatShareThemeEmoji】 and 【54†ChatShareThemeUniqueGift】, and the field share_theme to the class 【49†ChatFullInfo】, describing the theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat.
L42:   * Added the classes 【55†EmojiType】, 【56†EmojiTypeEmoji】 and 【57†EmojiTypeCustomEmoji】.
L43:   * Added the classes 【58†ChatShareThemeBackdrop】 and 【59†ChatShareThemeBackdrops】 and the method 【60†getChatShareThemeBackdrops】.
L44: 
L45: Gifts
L46:   * Added the method 【61†getUniqueGift】, allowing bots to get information about a unique gift by its name.
L47:   * Added the method 【62†deleteBusinessAccountGift】, allowing bots to delete regular gifts owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for them.
L48: 
L49: General
L50:   * Allowed users with a Telegram Premium subscription to assign secondary usernames ending with “agent”, “ai”, “app”, “game”, or “gay” to up to 2 owned bots. Such usernames can be suggested in the field suggested_username of the class 【63†KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot】.
L51:   * Added the class 【64†RichTextTonAddress】 representing an address in the TON blockchain in a 【43†RichMessage】.
L52:   * Added the type “ton_address” to the class 【65†MessageEntity】 for addresses in the TON blockchain.
L53:   * Added the type “bank_card_number” to the class 【65†MessageEntity】 for bank card numbers.
L54:   * Added the parameters custom_description_parse_mode and custom_description_entities to the methods 【66†verifyUser】 and 【67†verifyChat】.
L55:   * Added the class 【68†PaidMessagesWaived】 and the field paid_messages_waived to the class 【5†Message】 for service messages about the sender using a link which allows sending messages without paying Telegram Stars.
L56:   * Added the ability to create links to topics in private chats with the bot in the format `https://t.me/<bot_username>/<message_thread_id>`. Such a link opens the topic only for the user in the private chat with whom the topic exists.
L57: #### August 24, 2026
L58: 
L59: Bot API 10.3
L60: 
L61: Rich Messages
L62:   * Added the class 【69†RichMessageButton】 representing a button in a 【43†RichMessage】.
L63:   * Added the class 【70†RichTextButton】.
L64:   * Added the classes 【71†RichBlockButtons】 and 【72†InputRichBlockButtons】.
L65:   * Added the field is_compact to the classes 【73†RichBlockTable】 and 【74†InputRichBlockTable】.
L66:   * Added the classes 【75†RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation】 and 【76†InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation】 representing a block quotation, which can be expanded or collapsed back.
L67:   * Added the classes 【77†RichBlockDocument】 and 【78†InputRichBlockDocument】, containing a file.
L68:   * Added support for links of the form `tg://document?id=` for general file uploads in rich messages.
L69: Ephemeral messages
L70:   * Added the class 【41†EphemeralMessageParameters】 and replaced the parameters receiver_user_id and callback_query_id in the methods 【27†sendMessage】, 【29†sendAnimation】, 【30†sendAudio】, 【32†sendDocument】, 【33†sendLivePhoto】, 【35†sendPhoto】, 【36†sendSticker】, 【38†sendVideo】, 【39†sendVideoNote】, 【40†sendVoice】, 【31†sendContact】, 【34†sendLocation】 and 【37†sendVenue】 with the parameter ephemeral_message_parameters.
L71:   * Added the parameter ephemeral_message_parameters to the method 【28†sendRichMessage】.

L9: > Subscribe to 【2†@BotNews†t.me】 to be the first to know about the latest updates and join the discussion in 【3†@BotTalk†t.me】
L10: #### November 9, 2026
L11: 
L12: Bot API 10.4
L13: 
L14: Widgets
L15:   * Added the class 【4†Widget】 and the field widget to the classes 【5†Message】 and 【6†ExternalReplyInfo】 for messages with 【7†HTML widgets】.
L16:   * Added the method 【8†sendWidget】, allowing bots to send messages with HTML widgets. Currently, in the production environment, widgets can be sent only to private chats, and sent widgets automatically have protected content and therefore can't be forwarded.
L17:   * Added the method 【9†sendSharedWidget】, allowing bots to send again shared widgets created by the bot.
L18:   * Added the class 【10†WidgetQuery】 and the field widget_query to the class 【11†Update】 for queries sent to the bot by widgets in messages sent by the bot or via the bot.
L19:   * Added the class 【12†SharedWidgetQuery】 and the field shared_widget_query to the class 【11†Update】 for queries sent to the bot from forwarded messages with shared widgets.
L20:   * Added the classes 【13†WidgetQueryType】, 【14†WidgetQueryTypeData】, 【15†WidgetQueryTypeSignData】, 【16†WidgetQueryTypeSentTransaction】 and 【17†WidgetQueryWallet】, describing the type of a query from a widget. A query can contain data for the bot together with the TON wallet card of the user, data signed by a TON wallet of the user, or a notification about a transaction sent from a TON wallet of the user.
L21:   * Added the method 【18†answerWidgetQuery】, allowing bots to answer queries from widgets.
L22:   * Added the method 【19†editMessageWidgetData】, allowing bots to change data of a widget in a message.
L23:   * Added the method 【20†editSharedWidgetData】, allowing bots to change public data of a shared widget.
L24:   * Added the classes 【21†InputWidgetMessageContent】 and 【22†InputSharedWidgetMessageContent】, allowing bots to send widgets in response to inline queries. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.
L25:   * Widget messages can't be copied using the methods 【23†copyMessage】 and 【24†copyMessages】.
L26:   * The right can_send_other_messages in the classes 【25†ChatPermissions】 and 【26†ChatMemberRestricted】 now also allows sending widgets.
L27: Ephemeral messages
L28:   * Allowed bots to send ephemeral replies to callback queries in any chat except channel direct messages chats by specifying callback_query_id without receiver_user_id in the parameter ephemeral_message_parameters of the methods 【27†sendMessage】, 【28†sendRichMessage】, 【29†sendAnimation】, 【30†sendAudio】, 【31†sendContact】, 【32†sendDocument】, 【33†sendLivePhoto】, 【34†sendLocation】, 【35†sendPhoto】, 【36†sendSticker】, 【37†sendVenue】, 【38†sendVideo】, 【39†sendVideoNote】 and 【40†sendVoice】.
L29:   * The field receiver_user_id of the class 【41†EphemeralMessageParameters】 and the parameter chat_id of the mentioned methods are optional now.
L30: Quotes from rich messages
L31: 
L32:   * Added the field rich_texts to the class 【42†TextQuote】 for quotes chosen from a 【43†RichMessage】.
L33:   * Added the field quote_rich_texts to the class 【44†ReplyParameters】, allowing bots to quote rich messages.
L34: 
L35: TON wallet
L36:   * Added the classes 【45†TonWalletCard】, 【46†TonWalletCardSticker】, 【47†TonNft】 and 【48†TonNftAttribute】, and the field ton_wallet_card to the class 【49†ChatFullInfo】.
L37:   * Added the class 【50†TonWalletTransfer】 and the field ton_wallet_transfer to the class 【5†Message】 for service messages about transfers with a TON wallet.
L38:   * Renamed the class StoryAreaPosition to 【51†AreaPosition】, because it is now also used to describe the position of stickers on TON wallet cards.
L39: 
L40: Chat share themes
L41:   * Added the classes 【52†ChatShareTheme】, 【53†ChatShareThemeEmoji】 and 【54†ChatShareThemeUniqueGift】, and the field share_theme to the class 【49†ChatFullInfo】, describing the theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat.
L42:   * Added the classes 【55†EmojiType】, 【56†EmojiTypeEmoji】 and 【57†EmojiTypeCustomEmoji】.
L43:   * Added the classes 【58†ChatShareThemeBackdrop】 and 【59†ChatShareThemeBackdrops】 and the method 【60†getChatShareThemeBackdrops】.
L44: 
L45: Gifts
L46:   * Added the method 【61†getUniqueGift】, allowing bots to get information about a unique gift by its name.
L47:   * Added the method 【62†deleteBusinessAccountGift】, allowing bots to delete regular gifts owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for them.
L48: 
L49: General
L50:   * Allowed users with a Telegram Premium subscription to assign secondary usernames ending with “agent”, “ai”, “app”, “game”, or “gay” to up to 2 owned bots. Such usernames can be suggested in the field suggested_username of the class 【63†KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot】.
L51:   * Added the class 【64†RichTextTonAddress】 representing an address in the TON blockchain in a 【43†RichMessage】.
L52:   * Added the type “ton_address” to the class 【65†MessageEntity】 for addresses in the TON blockchain.
L53:   * Added the type “bank_card_number” to the class 【65†MessageEntity】 for bank card numbers.
L54:   * Added the parameters custom_description_parse_mode and custom_description_entities to the methods 【66†verifyUser】 and 【67†verifyChat】.
L55:   * Added the class 【68†PaidMessagesWaived】 and the field paid_messages_waived to the class 【5†Message】 for service messages about the sender using a link which allows sending messages without paying Telegram Stars.
L56:   * Added the ability to create links to topics in private chats with the bot in the format `https://t.me/<bot_username>/<message_thread_id>`. Such a link opens the topic only for the user in the private chat with whom the topic exists.
L57: #### August 24, 2026
L58: 
L59: Bot API 10.3
L60: 
L61: Rich Messages
L62:   * Added the class 【69†RichMessageButton】 representing a button in a 【43†RichMessage】.
L63:   * Added the class 【70†RichTextButton】.
L64:   * Added the classes 【71†RichBlockButtons】 and 【72†InputRichBlockButtons】.
L65:   * Added the field is_compact to the classes 【73†RichBlockTable】 and 【74†InputRichBlockTable】.
L66:   * Added the classes 【75†RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation】 and 【76†InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation】 representing a block quotation, which can be expanded or collapsed back.
L67:   * Added the classes 【77†RichBlockDocument】 and 【78†InputRichBlockDocument】, containing a file.
L68:   * Added support for links of the form `tg://document?id=` for general file uploads in rich messages.
L69: Ephemeral messages

item.text:
Только стандартная библиотека Python. Подставь токен бота и `chat_id`:

```python
import json
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

TOKEN = "ВАШ_ТОКЕН"
CHAT_ID = 123456789

payload = {
    "chat_id": CHAT_ID,
    "text": "🔥 Скидка сегодня",
    "entities": [
        {"type": "bold", "offset": 3, "length": 6}
    ],
}

request = Request(
    f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TOKEN}/sendMessage",
    data=json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST",
)

with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
    print(json.load(response))
```

В Bot API `offset` и `length` считаются в **кодовых единицах UTF-16**, с нуля. `🔥` занимает 2 единицы, пробел — 1, поэтому **`offset = 3`**. В слове «Скидка» 6 букв по одной единице: **`length = 6`**. `parse_mode` не передаётся. [Документация](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageentity).
